known_blockers: No current browser, mobile, keyboard or live-service run was possible in this deep dive.

No operational evidence was found for rate limiting, CAPTCHA, spam/abuse review, incident ownership, retention, staff notification or response SLA.
The schema contains disposition fields, but no inspected client or operating record proved who can triage them or how a writer receives an accountable outcome.
Plausible and Clarity are installed, but no Town Hall privacy-safe event contract, aggregate pull, baseline or review cadence is wired.
The requested crisp straight-on operable-lobby art direction has not been owner-approved as achieved in this report.
